# Quill

> Quill turns one set of property notes into a complete listing pack for UK estate agents and US real estate teams. Speak or type the facts once and generate a portal-ready description (or MLS-ready remarks), 6–10 generated Key Features bullets, a short teaser summary, an Email Blast (database email campaign copy — Quill doesn't send emails) and social captions for Instagram, Facebook and X.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, UK/US markets, brand voices, workflow and pricing.
- [UK property listing generator](/uk-property-listing-generator): Deep dive on the UK workflow — Material Information, Rightmove/OnTheMarket-style descriptions, generated Key Features bullets and compliance.
- [US real estate listing generator](/us-real-estate-listing-generator): Deep dive on the US workflow — MLS remarks, generated Key Features highlights, Fair Housing guidance and disclosures.

## Guides

- [Property listing copy guides](/blog): Hub of evergreen listing-copy guides for UK and US agents.
- [Property description examples (UK)](/property-description-examples): Worked UK property descriptions across flats, terraces, semis and country homes, annotated.
- [Rightmove-style description template (UK)](/rightmove-property-description-template): Paragraph-by-paragraph UK template plus a pre-publish checklist. Not affiliated with Rightmove.
- [MLS remarks examples (US)](/mls-remarks-examples): US public-remarks examples, a reusable template and fair-housing-conscious wording habits.
- [Real estate listing description examples (US)](/real-estate-listing-description-examples): Longer-form US listing descriptions by home type, shown in three tones.
